---
title: "Physical AI"
subtitle: "Machine Learning Systems That Sense and Act"
---

Build and evaluate a machine that senses, proposes an action, delegates permission
to an independent governor, and measures what happens before deciding again.
The course draws on [MLSysBook Volume IV](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol4/) and its
[Physical AI studio labs](https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/vol4/README.html).

## Course offerings

[**ETH Zurich · Spring 2027**](eth-spring-2027/index.qmd) — draft course plan for a
project seminar and hardware studio taught by Vijay Janapa Reddi, with teaching
assistant Andrea Mattia Garavagno. The offering page contains the course overview,
syllabus, schedule, and links to the labs.

For reusable teaching guidance, visit the
[Instructor Hub](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/). To discover courses across
institutions, use the [community course directory](https://mlsysbook.ai/courses/).
